review.body:
### Keep fixed-width padding out of the shared formatter

**Severity:** `medium`

The fixed-width spaces are currently emitted by the shared speed-formatting helpers, so every caller receives presentation padding that is only needed by the dock band. Please keep the formatter output canonical and apply numeric-field padding only when assigning the dock-band upload/download titles. Add boundary cases just below 100 Mbps/MB/s/MiB/s and Gbps/GB/s/GiB/s so values that round to 100 retain the intended width without regressing unit transitions.
